Associate a notification scheme with a space or space board
Now that the scheme is created, you can associate the scheme with the spaces that you want to use it. Once associated, any events on that space or its board will trigger the notifications that you configured in the scheme.
To associate a notification scheme to a space (and its board):
- Select Settings (), then Spaces.
- Search for and select the space you want to associate the notification scheme with.
- Next to the name of your space in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Space settings.
- Select Notifications.
- Select the Actions dropdown menu and choose Use a different scheme.
- On the subsequent Associate Notification Scheme to Space page, which lists all available notification schemes, select the notification scheme you want to associate with the space and select the Associate button.
Events
Jira apps support the following events, which can generate email notifications (as defined in a notification scheme).
| Event | Description | 
|---|---|
| Work item created | A work item has been entered into the system. | 
| Work item updated | A work item has had its details changed. This includes the deletion of a work item comment. | 
| Work item assigned | A work item has been assigned to a new user. | 
| Work item resolved | A work item has been resolved (usually after being worked on and fixed). | 
| Work item closed | A work item has been closed (note that a work item may be closed without being resolved). | 
| Work item commented | A work item has had a comment added to it. | 
| Work item comment edited | A work item's comment has been modified. | 
| Work item reopened | A work item has been re-opened. | 
| Work item deleted | A work item has been deleted. | 
| Work item moved | A work item has been moved into or out of this space. | 
| Work logged on work item | A work item has had hours logged against it (i.e. a worklog has been added). | 
| Work started on work item | The Assignee has started working on a work item. | 
| Work stopped on work item | The Assignee has stopped working on a work item. | 
| Work item worklog updated | An entry in a work item's worklog has been modified. | 
| Work item worklog deleted | An entry in a work item's worklog has been deleted. | 
| Generic event | The exact nature of this event depends on the workflow transition(s) from it was fired. | 
| Custom event(s) | The exact nature of these events depends on the workflow transition(s) from which they were fired. |
